issues.desc: background.md Conversational Texture uses the abbreviation "3x2" ("genuine Claude+Codex dual-host (3x2) review per round") without defining what it means. A new reader cannot tell whether 3x2 means 3 reviewers x 2 hosts, 3 rounds x 2 reviewers, or something else. First definition of the abbreviation is missing.

background.md Trigger Event references story B-7559 by ID only ("story B-7559 audited and merged docs/parallel-decomposition-spec.md to main") with no one-sentence explanation of what that story was or why it is relevant context. Per Dimension 2, cross-story references should have a brief explanation on first appearance.

Checklist does not mention barrel/index.ts or impl skeleton files that Section 3.1 of the spec prescribes for Story 0; verify whether this decomposition genuinely needs only a single module file (if so, the barrel pattern is inapplicable and the current scope is correct).
